#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;
constexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;

// Index calculation for flattened 2D array
inline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {
    return j * n + i;
}

void initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, 
                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);
    }
    
    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;
    }
}

void initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {
    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;
            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;
        }
        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;
    }
}

void floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, 
                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, 
                   const size_t numNodes) {
    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm
    // For each intermediate node k
    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
        // For each source node i
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            // For each destination node j
            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;
                
                if (newDist < distIJ) {
                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;
                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {
    // Basic sanity checks
    
    // 1. Diagonal should be zero
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {
            printf("Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\n", i, i);
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]
    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {
            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                // Check for overflow before addition
                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {
                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {
                        printf("Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\n", 
                               i, j, k);
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t numNodes = 512;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\n");
    printf("Number of nodes: %zu\n", numNodes);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Allocate matrices
    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);
    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);
    
    // Initialize
    printf("Initializing graph...\n");
    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);
    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);
    
    // Run Floyd-Warshall
    printf("Computing shortest paths...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Calculate operations per second
    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity
    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;
    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;
    printf("Performance: %.3f GOPS\n", gflops);
    
    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)
    if (printResults) {
        print_results_int(dist, "DistanceMatrix");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;
constexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;

// Index calculation for flattened 2D array
inline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {
    return j * n + i;
}

void initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, 
                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);
    }
    
    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;
    }
}

void initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {
    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;
            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;
        }
        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;
    }
}

void floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, 
                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, 
                   const size_t numNodes) {
    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm
    // For each intermediate node k
    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
        // For each source node i
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            // For each destination node j
            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;
                
                if (newDist < distIJ) {
                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;
                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {
    // Basic sanity checks
    
    // 1. Diagonal should be zero
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {
            printf("Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\n", i, i);
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]
    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {
            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                // Check for overflow before addition
                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {
                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {
                        printf("Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\n", 
                               i, j, k);
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;
constexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;

// Index calculation for flattened 2D array
inline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {
    return j * n + i;
}

void initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, 
                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);
    }
    
    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;
    }
}

void initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {
    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;
            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;
        }
        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;
    }
}

void floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, 
                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, 
                   const size_t numNodes) {
    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm
    // For each intermediate node k
    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
        // For each source node i
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
            // For each destination node j
            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;
                
                if (newDist < distIJ) {
                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;
                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {
    // Basic sanity checks
    
    // 1. Diagonal should be zero
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {
        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {
            printf("Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\n", i, i);
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]
    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {
            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {
                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];
                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];
                
                // Check for overflow before addition
                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {
                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {
                        printf("Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\n", 
                               i, j, k);
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t numNodes = 512;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\n");
    printf("Number of nodes: %zu\n", numNodes);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Allocate matrices
    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);
    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);
    
    // Initialize
    printf("Initializing graph...\n");
    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);
    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);
    
    // Run Floyd-Warshall
    printf("Computing shortest paths...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Calculate operations per second
    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity
    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;
    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;
    printf("Performance: %.3f GOPS\n", gflops);
    
    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)
    if (printResults) {
        print_results_int(dist, "DistanceMatrix");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

constexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;
constexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;
constexpr int TILE = 64;
constexpr int THREAD_ROWS = 8;

void mpiCheck(int error) {
    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
    int length = 0;
    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error: %.*s\\n\", length, message);
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    std::abort();
}

void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error) {
    if (error == cudaSuccess) return;
    int rank = 0;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: CUDA error: %s\\n\", rank, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
    std::abort();
}

struct MpiEnvironment {
    MpiEnvironment(int& argc, char**& argv) {
        int provided = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\\n\");
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
    }
    ~MpiEnvironment() { MPI_Finalize(); }
};

template<bool Pinned = false> struct CudaBuffer {
    unsigned int* data = nullptr;
    explicit CudaBuffer(size_t elements) {
        if constexpr (Pinned)
            cudaCheck(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), elements * sizeof(unsigned int)));
        else
            cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), elements * sizeof(unsigned int)));
    }
    ~CudaBuffer() {
        if constexpr (Pinned) cudaFreeHost(data);
        else cudaFree(data);
    }
    CudaBuffer(const CudaBuffer&) = delete;
    CudaBuffer& operator=(const CudaBuffer&) = delete;
};

// glibc rand_r uses three LCG steps per output. Jump whole outputs so every
// distributed row reproduces the original, single seed-42 random sequence.
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
unsigned int rowSeed(size_t outputs) {
    uint32_t multiplier = 1, increment = 0;
    for (int step = 0; step < 3; ++step) {
        multiplier *= 1103515245u;
        increment = increment * 1103515245u + 12345u;
    }
    uint32_t seed = 42;
    while (outputs) {
        if (outputs & 1) seed = multiplier * seed + increment;
        increment *= multiplier + 1u;
        multiplier *= multiplier;
        outputs >>= 1;
    }
    return seed;
}
#endif

void initializeLocalDistances(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, size_t n,
                              size_t pitch, int rank, int ranks) {
    const size_t rows = dist.size() / pitch;
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
        const size_t globalRow = (row / TILE * ranks + rank) * TILE + row % TILE;
        unsigned int* values = dist.data() + row * pitch;
        std::fill(values, values + pitch, INF);
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
        if (globalRow < n) {
            unsigned int seed = rowSeed(globalRow * n);
            for (size_t col = 0; col < n; ++col)
                values[col] = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
                    static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
        }
#endif
        values[globalRow] = 0;
    }
#if "'!defined(__GLIBC__)
    // Other libcs can implement rand_r differently. Replay their actual RNG
    // without assuming an implementation-specific skip-ahead formula.
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
        const bool owned = static_cast<int>(row / TILE % ranks) == rank;
        const size_t localRow = row / (TILE * ranks) * TILE + row % TILE;
        for (size_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            const unsigned int value = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
                static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
            if (owned) dist[localRow * pitch + col] = row == col ? 0 : value;
        }
    }
#endif
}

__global__ void initializePaths(unsigned int* path, size_t elements,
                                size_t pitch, int rank, int ranks) {
    for (size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;
         i < elements; i += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
        const size_t row = i / pitch;
        path[i] = static_cast<unsigned int>((row / TILE * ranks + rank) * TILE + row % TILE);
    }
}

// Record both operands and pivot-row snapshots at their original k iteration.
// Ordinary blocked Floyd-Warshall can change path tie breaking; these histories
// preserve the scalar algorithm'"'s strict-improvement updates exactly.
__global__ void pivotHistory(const unsigned int* dist, size_t pitch,
                             size_t localBase, size_t globalBase,
                             unsigned int* operands, unsigned int* snapshots) {
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            tile[row][col] = dist[(localBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col];
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (col == k) operands[row * TILE + k] = tile[row][col];
                if (row == k) snapshots[k * TILE + col] = tile[row][col];
                // The zero diagonal makes the pivot row/column immutable at k.
                // Do not write them while other threads read their operands.
                if (row "'!= k && col != k)
                    tile[row][col] = min(tile[row][col], tile[row][k] + tile[k][col]);
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

__global__ void pivotRows(const unsigned int* dist, size_t pitch,
                          size_t localBase, int pivotBlock,
                          const unsigned int* operands,
                          const unsigned int* diagonal,
                          unsigned int* panel) {
    const int colBlock = blockIdx.x;
    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(colBlock) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int left[TILE][TILE];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            if (colBlock == pivotBlock) {
                panel[row * pitch + colBase + col] = diagonal[row * TILE + col];
            } else {
                tile[row][col] = dist[(localBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col];
                left[row][col] = operands[row * TILE + col];
            }
        }
    }
    if (colBlock == pivotBlock) return;
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (row == k) panel[k * pitch + colBase + col] = tile[row][col];
                else tile[row][col] = min(tile[row][col], left[row][k] + tile[k][col]);
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

__global__ void columnHistory(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,
                              size_t pitch, size_t globalBase,
                              const unsigned int* diagonal, unsigned int* operands) {
    const size_t rowBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int right[TILE][TILE];
    unsigned int last[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            tile[row][col] = dist[(rowBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col];
            right[row][col] = diagonal[row * TILE + col];
            last[ry][cx] = UNCHANGED;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (col == k) operands[(rowBase + row) * TILE + k] = tile[row][col];
                else {
                    const unsigned int candidate = tile[row][k] + right[k][col];
                    if (candidate < tile[row][col]) {
                        tile[row][col] = candidate;
                        last[ry][cx] = k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            const size_t index = (rowBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col;
            dist[index] = tile[row][col];
            if (last[ry][cx] != UNCHANGED) path[index] = globalBase + last[ry][cx];
        }
    }
}

__global__ void updateTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path, size_t pitch,
                            int pivotBlock, size_t rowBlockOffset,
                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ operands,
                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel) {
    const int colBlock = blockIdx.x + (static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) >= pivotBlock);
    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(colBlock) * TILE;
    const size_t rowBase = (rowBlockOffset + blockIdx.y) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int left[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int right[TILE][TILE];
    unsigned int values[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    unsigned int last[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            left[row][col] = operands[(rowBase + row) * TILE + col];
            right[row][col] = panel[row * pitch + colBase + col];
            values[ry][cx] = dist[(rowBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col];
            last[ry][cx] = UNCHANGED;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 4
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            const unsigned int distanceIK = left[row][k];
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                const unsigned int candidate = distanceIK + right[k][col];
                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
                    last[ry][cx] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            const size_t index = (rowBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col;
            dist[index] = values[ry][cx];
            if (last[ry][cx] != UNCHANGED) path[index] = pivotBlock * TILE + last[ry][cx];
        }
    }
}

void floydWarshall(CudaBuffer<>& dist, CudaBuffer<>& path, size_t pitch,
                   int blocks, int localBlocks, int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    CudaBuffer<> columnOperands(static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE * TILE);
    CudaBuffer<> pivotOperands(TILE * TILE), diagonal(TILE * TILE), panel(TILE * pitch);
    CudaBuffer<true> hostDiagonal(TILE * TILE), hostPanel(TILE * pitch);
    CudaStream compute, broadcast;
    CudaEvent updated, diagonalReady, panelConsumed;
    cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(updated.value, compute.value));
    cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(panelConsumed.value, compute.value));
    const dim3 threads(THREAD_COLS, THREAD_ROWS);
    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests((TILE * pitch + INT_MAX - 1) / INT_MAX);

    for (int pivot = 0; pivot < blocks; ++pivot) {
        const int owner = pivot % ranks;
        const size_t globalBase = static_cast<size_t>(pivot) * TILE;
        if (rank == owner) {
            cudaCheck(cudaStreamWaitEvent(broadcast.value, updated.value, 0));
            pivotHistory<<<1, threads, 0, broadcast.value>>>(
                dist.data, pitch, static_cast<size_t>(pivot / ranks) * TILE,
                globalBase, pivotOperands.data, diagonal.data);
            cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.data, diagonal.data, TILE * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, broadcast.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(diagonalReady.value, broadcast.value));
            pivotRows<<<blocks, threads, 0, broadcast.value>>>(
                dist.data, pitch, static_cast<size_t>(pivot / ranks) * TILE,
                pivot, pivotOperands.data, diagonal.data, panel.data);
            cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(panelConsumed.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostPanel.data, panel.data, TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, broadcast.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(diagonalReady.value));
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.data, TILE * TILE, MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, comm));
        if (rank != owner)
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(diagonal.data, hostDiagonal.data, TILE * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, compute.value));
        columnHistory<<<localBlocks, threads, 0, compute.value>>>(
            dist.data, path.data, pitch, globalBase, diagonal.data, columnOperands.data);
        cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());

        // The small diagonal lets local column work overlap the large row-panel
        // collective. Staging works with MPI implementations lacking CUDA awareness.
        if (rank == owner) cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(broadcast.value));
        cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(panelConsumed.value));
        size_t offset = 0;
        for (MPI_Request& request : requests) {
            const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(TILE * pitch - offset, static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(hostPanel.data + offset, count, MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, comm, &request));
            offset += count;
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(compute.value));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
        cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(panel.data, hostPanel.data, TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, compute.value));
        cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(panelConsumed.value, compute.value));
        if (blocks > 1) {
            for (int rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < localBlocks; rowOffset += 65535) {
                const dim3 grid(blocks - 1, std::min(localBlocks - rowOffset, 65535));
                updateTiles<<<grid, threads, 0, compute.value>>>(
                    dist.data, path.data, pitch, pivot, rowOffset, columnOperands.data, panel.data);
                cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            }
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(updated.value, compute.value));
    }
    cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(compute.value));
}

// Gather block-cyclic rows directly into row-major order. MPI datatypes omit
// padded columns and avoid an additional full-sized packing buffer on rank 0.
std::vector<unsigned int> gatherMatrix(const unsigned int* device, size_t n,
                                       size_t pitch, int localBlocks,
                                       int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    if (n == 0) return {};
    std::vector<unsigned int> local(static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE * pitch);
    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(local.data(), device, local.size() * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    MPI_Datatype rows, sendType, recvType;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_vector(TILE, static_cast<int>(n), static_cast<int>(pitch), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_create_resized(rows, 0, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int)), &sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_commit(&sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_vector(TILE, static_cast<int>(n), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_create_resized(rows, 0, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(ranks) * TILE * n * sizeof(unsigned int), &recvType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_commit(&recvType));
    std::vector<unsigned int> result;
    if (rank == 0) {
        result.resize(pitch * n);
        std::vector<MPI_Request> requests(ranks - 1);
        const int blocks = static_cast<int>(pitch / TILE);
        for (int peer = 1; peer < ranks; ++peer) {
            const int peerBlocks = (blocks + ranks - 1 - peer) / ranks;
            mpiCheck(MPI_Irecv(result.data() + static_cast<size_t>(peer) * TILE * n,
                               peerBlocks, recvType, peer, 0, comm, &requests[peer - 1]));
        }
        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
        for (size_t row = 0; row < static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE; ++row) {
            const size_t globalRow = (row / TILE * ranks) * TILE + row % TILE;
            std::memcpy(result.data() + globalRow * n, local.data() + row * pitch, n * sizeof(unsigned int));
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
        result.resize(n * n);
    } else {
        mpiCheck(MPI_Send(local.data(), localBlocks, sendType, 0, 0, comm));
    }
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&recvType));
    return result;
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, size_t n) {
    bool valid = true;
    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(&&:valid) schedule(static)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) valid = valid && dist[i * n + i] == 0;
    const size_t sample = std::min(n, static_cast<size_t>(10));
    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) reduction(&&:valid) schedule(static)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sample; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < sample; ++j) {
            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (dist[i * n + k] < INF && dist[k * n + j] < INF)
                    valid = valid && dist[i * n + k] + dist[k * n + j] >= dist[i * n + j];
            }
        }
    }
    return valid;
}

bool validateExact(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,
                   const std::vector<unsigned int>& path, size_t n) {
    std::vector<unsigned int> reference(n * n), referencePath(n * n);
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < reference.size(); ++i)
        reference[i] = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
            static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        reference[i * n + i] = 0;
        std::fill(referencePath.begin() + i * n, referencePath.begin() + (i + 1) * n, i);
    }
    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                const unsigned int candidate = reference[i * n + k] + reference[k * n + j];
                if (candidate < reference[i * n + j]) {
                    reference[i * n + j] = candidate;
                    referencePath[i * n + j] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (dist != reference || path != referencePath) {
        printf("Validation failed: distance or path matrix differs from the scalar algorithm'"\\n\");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* name) {
    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", name);
    printf(\"Options:\\n\");
    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");
    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");
    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");
    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    MpiEnvironment mpi(argc, argv);
    int worldRank = 0, worldRanks = 1;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRanks));
    try {
        size_t n = 512;
        bool validate = false, printResults = false;
        for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
            if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
                const char* text = argv[++i];
                char* end = nullptr;
                errno = 0;
                const unsigned long long value = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
                if (errno || end == text || *end || *text == '-' || value > INT_MAX - TILE) {
                    if (worldRank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Invalid number of nodes: %s\\n\", text);
                    return 1;
                }
                n = static_cast<size_t>(value);
            } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) validate = true;
            else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) printResults = true;
            else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {
                if (worldRank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
                return 0;
            } else {
                if (worldRank == 0) {
                    printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);
                    printUsage(argv[0]);
                }
                return 1;
            }
        }

        const int blocks = static_cast<int>(std::max(size_t{1}, (n + TILE - 1) / TILE));
        const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * TILE;
        const int ranks = std::min(worldRanks, blocks);
        MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_NULL, shared = MPI_COMM_NULL;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shared));
        int localRank = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(shared, &localRank));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_free(&shared));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < ranks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &comm));
        if (worldRank >= ranks) return 0;

        // One GPU per MPI rank, respecting per-rank CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
        // Extra ranks on a node may share a device when explicitly oversubscribed.
        int deviceCount = 0;
        cudaCheck(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
        if (deviceCount == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: a CUDA device is required.\\n\", worldRank);
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));
        // Respect explicit OpenMP settings; avoid spawning hundreds of threads
        // by default for initialization and small result gathers.
        if ("'!std::getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS"))
            omp_set_num_threads(std::min(8, omp_get_max_threads()));
        const int localBlocks = (blocks + ranks - 1 - worldRank) / ranks;
        const size_t localRows = static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE;
        if (pitch > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / pitch / sizeof(unsigned int)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Matrix dimensions exceed the addressable size.'"\\n\");
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
        CudaBuffer<> dist(localRows * pitch), path(localRows * pitch);
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");
            printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", n);
            printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");
            printf(\"MPI ranks: %d; OpenMP threads per rank: %d; CUDA tile: %d\\n\", ranks, omp_get_max_threads(), TILE);
            printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");
        }
        {
            std::vector<unsigned int> initial(localRows * pitch);
            initializeLocalDistances(initial, n, pitch, worldRank, ranks);
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(dist.data, initial.data(), initial.size() * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        }
        initializePaths<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min(size_t{65535}, (localRows * pitch + 255) / 256)), 256>>>(
            path.data, localRows * pitch, pitch, worldRank, ranks);
        cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
        cudaCheck(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
        if (worldRank == 0) printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");
        mpiCheck(MPI_Barrier(comm));
        const double start = MPI_Wtime();
        floydWarshall(dist, path, pitch, blocks, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
        double duration = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm));
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            printf(\"Computation time: %.3f ms\\n\", duration * 1000.0);
            const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * n * n;
            printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", duration > 0 ? operations / duration / 1e9 : 0.0);
        }
        std::vector<unsigned int> result, resultPath;
        if (printResults || validate)
            result = gatherMatrix(dist.data, n, pitch, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        if (validate && n <= 256)
            resultPath = gatherMatrix(path.data, n, pitch, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        int status = 0;
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            if (printResults) print_results_int(result, \"DistanceMatrix\");
            if (validate) {
                printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");
                bool valid = validateResult(result, n);
                if (n <= 256) valid = validateExact(result, resultPath, n) && valid;
                printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", valid ? \"PASSED\" : \"FAILED\");
                status = valid ? 0 : 1;
            }
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, comm));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_free(&comm));
        return status;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: %s\\n\", worldRank, error.what());
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        return 1;
    }
}

#include <algorithm>

constexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;
constexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;
constexpr int TILE = 64;
constexpr int THREAD_ROWS = 8;
constexpr int THREAD_COLS = 32;
constexpr unsigned int UNCHANGED = UINT_MAX;

void mpiCheck(int error) {
    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
    int length = 0;
    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    fprintf(stderr, "MPI error: %.*s\n", length, message);
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    std::abort();
}

void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error) {
    if (error == cudaSuccess) return;
    int rank = 0;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA error: %s\n", rank, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
    std::abort();
}

struct MpiEnvironment {
    MpiEnvironment(int& argc, char**& argv) {
        int provided = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
    }
    ~MpiEnvironment() { MPI_Finalize(); }
};

template<bool Pinned = false> struct CudaBuffer {
    unsigned int* data = nullptr;
    explicit CudaBuffer(size_t elements) {
        if constexpr (Pinned)
            cudaCheck(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), elements * sizeof(unsigned int)));
        else
            cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), elements * sizeof(unsigned int)));
    }
    ~CudaBuffer() {
        if constexpr (Pinned) cudaFreeHost(data);
        else cudaFree(data);
    }
    CudaBuffer(const CudaBuffer&) = delete;
    CudaBuffer& operator=(const CudaBuffer&) = delete;
};

struct CudaStream {
    cudaStream_t value;
    CudaStream() { cudaCheck(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&value, cudaStreamNonBlocking)); }
    ~CudaStream() { cudaStreamDestroy(value); }
};

struct CudaEvent {
    cudaEvent_t value;
    CudaEvent() { cudaCheck(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&value, cudaEventDisableTiming)); }
    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(value); }
};

// glibc rand_r uses three LCG steps per output. Jump whole outputs so every
// distributed row reproduces the original, single seed-42 random sequence.
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
unsigned int rowSeed(size_t outputs) {
    uint32_t multiplier = 1, increment = 0;
    for (int step = 0; step < 3; ++step) {
        multiplier *= 1103515245u;
        increment = increment * 1103515245u + 12345u;
    }
    uint32_t seed = 42;
    while (outputs) {
        if (outputs & 1) seed = multiplier * seed + increment;
        increment *= multiplier + 1u;
        multiplier *= multiplier;
        outputs >>= 1;
    }
    return seed;
}
#endif

void initializeLocalDistances(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, size_t n,
                              size_t pitch, int rank, int ranks) {
    const size_t rows = dist.size() / pitch;
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (size_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
        const size_t globalRow = (row / TILE * ranks + rank) * TILE + row % TILE;
        unsigned int* values = dist.data() + row * pitch;
        std::fill(values, values + pitch, INF);
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
        if (globalRow < n) {
            unsigned int seed = rowSeed(globalRow * n);
            for (size_t col = 0; col < n; ++col)
                values[col] = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
                    static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
        }
#endif
        values[globalRow] = 0;
    }
#if !defined(__GLIBC__)
    // Other libcs can implement rand_r differently. Replay their actual RNG
    // without assuming an implementation-specific skip-ahead formula.
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
        const bool owned = static_cast<int>(row / TILE % ranks) == rank;
        const size_t localRow = row / (TILE * ranks) * TILE + row % TILE;
        for (size_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            const unsigned int value = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
                static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
            if (owned) dist[localRow * pitch + col] = row == col ? 0 : value;
        }
    }
#endif
}

__global__ void initializePaths(unsigned int* path, size_t elements,
                                size_t pitch, int rank, int ranks) {
    for (size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;
         i < elements; i += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
        const size_t row = i / pitch;
        path[i] = static_cast<unsigned int>((row / TILE * ranks + rank) * TILE + row % TILE);
    }
}

// Record both operands and pivot-row snapshots at their original k iteration.
// Ordinary blocked Floyd-Warshall can change path tie breaking; these histories
// preserve the scalar algorithm's strict-improvement updates exactly.
__global__ void pivotHistory(const unsigned int* dist, size_t pitch,
                             size_t localBase, size_t globalBase,
                             unsigned int* operands, unsigned int* snapshots) {
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            tile[row][col] = dist[(localBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col];
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (col == k) operands[row * TILE + k] = tile[row][col];
                if (row == k) snapshots[k * TILE + col] = tile[row][col];
                // The zero diagonal makes the pivot row/column immutable at k.
                // Do not write them while other threads read their operands.
                if (row != k && col != k)
                    tile[row][col] = min(tile[row][col], tile[row][k] + tile[k][col]);
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

__global__ void pivotRows(const unsigned int* dist, size_t pitch,
                          size_t localBase, int pivotBlock,
                          const unsigned int* operands,
                          const unsigned int* diagonal,
                          unsigned int* panel) {
    const int colBlock = blockIdx.x;
    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(colBlock) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int left[TILE][TILE];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            if (colBlock == pivotBlock) {
                panel[row * pitch + colBase + col] = diagonal[row * TILE + col];
            } else {
                tile[row][col] = dist[(localBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col];
                left[row][col] = operands[row * TILE + col];
            }
        }
    }
    if (colBlock == pivotBlock) return;
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (row == k) panel[k * pitch + colBase + col] = tile[row][col];
                else tile[row][col] = min(tile[row][col], left[row][k] + tile[k][col]);
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

__global__ void columnHistory(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,
                              size_t pitch, size_t globalBase,
                              const unsigned int* diagonal, unsigned int* operands) {
    const size_t rowBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int right[TILE][TILE];
    unsigned int last[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            tile[row][col] = dist[(rowBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col];
            right[row][col] = diagonal[row * TILE + col];
            last[ry][cx] = UNCHANGED;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                if (col == k) operands[(rowBase + row) * TILE + k] = tile[row][col];
                else {
                    const unsigned int candidate = tile[row][k] + right[k][col];
                    if (candidate < tile[row][col]) {
                        tile[row][col] = candidate;
                        last[ry][cx] = k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            const size_t index = (rowBase + row) * pitch + globalBase + col;
            dist[index] = tile[row][col];
            if (last[ry][cx] != UNCHANGED) path[index] = globalBase + last[ry][cx];
        }
    }
}

__global__ void updateTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path, size_t pitch,
                            int pivotBlock, size_t rowBlockOffset,
                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ operands,
                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel) {
    const int colBlock = blockIdx.x + (static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) >= pivotBlock);
    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(colBlock) * TILE;
    const size_t rowBase = (rowBlockOffset + blockIdx.y) * TILE;
    __shared__ unsigned int left[TILE][TILE];
    __shared__ unsigned int right[TILE][TILE];
    unsigned int values[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    unsigned int last[TILE / THREAD_ROWS][TILE / THREAD_COLS];
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            left[row][col] = operands[(rowBase + row) * TILE + col];
            right[row][col] = panel[row * pitch + colBase + col];
            values[ry][cx] = dist[(rowBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col];
            last[ry][cx] = UNCHANGED;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    #pragma unroll 4
    for (int k = 0; k < TILE; ++k) {
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
            const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
            const unsigned int distanceIK = left[row][k];
            #pragma unroll
            for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
                const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
                const unsigned int candidate = distanceIK + right[k][col];
                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
                    last[ry][cx] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #pragma unroll
    for (int ry = 0; ry < TILE / THREAD_ROWS; ++ry) {
        const int row = threadIdx.y + ry * THREAD_ROWS;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int cx = 0; cx < TILE / THREAD_COLS; ++cx) {
            const int col = threadIdx.x + cx * THREAD_COLS;
            const size_t index = (rowBase + row) * pitch + colBase + col;
            dist[index] = values[ry][cx];
            if (last[ry][cx] != UNCHANGED) path[index] = pivotBlock * TILE + last[ry][cx];
        }
    }
}

void floydWarshall(CudaBuffer<>& dist, CudaBuffer<>& path, size_t pitch,
                   int blocks, int localBlocks, int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    CudaBuffer<> columnOperands(static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE * TILE);
    CudaBuffer<> pivotOperands(TILE * TILE), diagonal(TILE * TILE), panel(TILE * pitch);
    CudaBuffer<true> hostDiagonal(TILE * TILE), hostPanel(TILE * pitch);
    CudaStream compute, broadcast;
    CudaEvent updated, diagonalReady, panelConsumed;
    cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(updated.value, compute.value));
    cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(panelConsumed.value, compute.value));
    const dim3 threads(THREAD_COLS, THREAD_ROWS);
    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests((TILE * pitch + INT_MAX - 1) / INT_MAX);

    for (int pivot = 0; pivot < blocks; ++pivot) {
        const int owner = pivot % ranks;
        const size_t globalBase = static_cast<size_t>(pivot) * TILE;
        if (rank == owner) {
            cudaCheck(cudaStreamWaitEvent(broadcast.value, updated.value, 0));
            pivotHistory<<<1, threads, 0, broadcast.value>>>(
                dist.data, pitch, static_cast<size_t>(pivot / ranks) * TILE,
                globalBase, pivotOperands.data, diagonal.data);
            cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostDiagonal.data, diagonal.data, TILE * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, broadcast.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(diagonalReady.value, broadcast.value));
            pivotRows<<<blocks, threads, 0, broadcast.value>>>(
                dist.data, pitch, static_cast<size_t>(pivot / ranks) * TILE,
                pivot, pivotOperands.data, diagonal.data, panel.data);
            cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(panelConsumed.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostPanel.data, panel.data, TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, broadcast.value));
            cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(diagonalReady.value));
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(hostDiagonal.data, TILE * TILE, MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, comm));
        if (rank != owner)
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(diagonal.data, hostDiagonal.data, TILE * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, compute.value));
        columnHistory<<<localBlocks, threads, 0, compute.value>>>(
            dist.data, path.data, pitch, globalBase, diagonal.data, columnOperands.data);
        cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());

        // The small diagonal lets local column work overlap the large row-panel
        // collective. Staging works with MPI implementations lacking CUDA awareness.
        if (rank == owner) cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(broadcast.value));
        cudaCheck(cudaEventSynchronize(panelConsumed.value));
        size_t offset = 0;
        for (MPI_Request& request : requests) {
            const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(TILE * pitch - offset, static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(hostPanel.data + offset, count, MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, comm, &request));
            offset += count;
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(compute.value));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
        cudaCheck(cudaMemcpyAsync(panel.data, hostPanel.data, TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int),
                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, compute.value));
        cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(panelConsumed.value, compute.value));
        if (blocks > 1) {
            for (int rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < localBlocks; rowOffset += 65535) {
                const dim3 grid(blocks - 1, std::min(localBlocks - rowOffset, 65535));
                updateTiles<<<grid, threads, 0, compute.value>>>(
                    dist.data, path.data, pitch, pivot, rowOffset, columnOperands.data, panel.data);
                cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
            }
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaEventRecord(updated.value, compute.value));
    }
    cudaCheck(cudaStreamSynchronize(compute.value));
}

// Gather block-cyclic rows directly into row-major order. MPI datatypes omit
// padded columns and avoid an additional full-sized packing buffer on rank 0.
std::vector<unsigned int> gatherMatrix(const unsigned int* device, size_t n,
                                       size_t pitch, int localBlocks,
                                       int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    if (n == 0) return {};
    std::vector<unsigned int> local(static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE * pitch);
    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(local.data(), device, local.size() * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    MPI_Datatype rows, sendType, recvType;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_vector(TILE, static_cast<int>(n), static_cast<int>(pitch), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_create_resized(rows, 0, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(TILE * pitch * sizeof(unsigned int)), &sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_commit(&sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_vector(TILE, static_cast<int>(n), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_create_resized(rows, 0, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(ranks) * TILE * n * sizeof(unsigned int), &recvType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&rows));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_commit(&recvType));
    std::vector<unsigned int> result;
    if (rank == 0) {
        result.resize(pitch * n);
        std::vector<MPI_Request> requests(ranks - 1);
        const int blocks = static_cast<int>(pitch / TILE);
        for (int peer = 1; peer < ranks; ++peer) {
            const int peerBlocks = (blocks + ranks - 1 - peer) / ranks;
            mpiCheck(MPI_Irecv(result.data() + static_cast<size_t>(peer) * TILE * n,
                               peerBlocks, recvType, peer, 0, comm, &requests[peer - 1]));
        }
        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
        for (size_t row = 0; row < static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE; ++row) {
            const size_t globalRow = (row / TILE * ranks) * TILE + row % TILE;
            std::memcpy(result.data() + globalRow * n, local.data() + row * pitch, n * sizeof(unsigned int));
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
        result.resize(n * n);
    } else {
        mpiCheck(MPI_Send(local.data(), localBlocks, sendType, 0, 0, comm));
    }
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&sendType));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Type_free(&recvType));
    return result;
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, size_t n) {
    bool valid = true;
    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(&&:valid) schedule(static)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) valid = valid && dist[i * n + i] == 0;
    const size_t sample = std::min(n, static_cast<size_t>(10));
    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) reduction(&&:valid) schedule(static)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sample; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < sample; ++j) {
            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (dist[i * n + k] < INF && dist[k * n + j] < INF)
                    valid = valid && dist[i * n + k] + dist[k * n + j] >= dist[i * n + j];
            }
        }
    }
    return valid;
}

bool validateExact(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,
                   const std::vector<unsigned int>& path, size_t n) {
    std::vector<unsigned int> reference(n * n), referencePath(n * n);
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < reference.size(); ++i)
        reference[i] = 1u + static_cast<unsigned int>(
            static_cast<double>(MAX_DISTANCE) * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        reference[i * n + i] = 0;
        std::fill(referencePath.begin() + i * n, referencePath.begin() + (i + 1) * n, i);
    }
    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                const unsigned int candidate = reference[i * n + k] + reference[k * n + j];
                if (candidate < reference[i * n + j]) {
                    reference[i * n + j] = candidate;
                    referencePath[i * n + j] = k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (dist != reference || path != referencePath) {
        printf("Validation failed: distance or path matrix differs from the scalar algorithm\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* name) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", name);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    MpiEnvironment mpi(argc, argv);
    int worldRank = 0, worldRanks = 1;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank));
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRanks));
    try {
        size_t n = 512;
        bool validate = false, printResults = false;
        for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
            if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
                const char* text = argv[++i];
                char* end = nullptr;
                errno = 0;
                const unsigned long long value = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
                if (errno || end == text || *end || *text == '-' || value > INT_MAX - TILE) {
                    if (worldRank == 0) fprintf(stderr, "Invalid number of nodes: %s\n", text);
                    return 1;
                }
                n = static_cast<size_t>(value);
            } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) validate = true;
            else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) printResults = true;
            else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
                if (worldRank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
                return 0;
            } else {
                if (worldRank == 0) {
                    printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
                    printUsage(argv[0]);
                }
                return 1;
            }
        }

        const int blocks = static_cast<int>(std::max(size_t{1}, (n + TILE - 1) / TILE));
        const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * TILE;
        const int ranks = std::min(worldRanks, blocks);
        MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_NULL, shared = MPI_COMM_NULL;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shared));
        int localRank = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(shared, &localRank));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_free(&shared));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < ranks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &comm));
        if (worldRank >= ranks) return 0;

        // One GPU per MPI rank, respecting per-rank CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
        // Extra ranks on a node may share a device when explicitly oversubscribed.
        int deviceCount = 0;
        cudaCheck(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
        if (deviceCount == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: a CUDA device is required.\n", worldRank);
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
        cudaCheck(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));
        // Respect explicit OpenMP settings; avoid spawning hundreds of threads
        // by default for initialization and small result gathers.
        if (!std::getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS"))
            omp_set_num_threads(std::min(8, omp_get_max_threads()));
        const int localBlocks = (blocks + ranks - 1 - worldRank) / ranks;
        const size_t localRows = static_cast<size_t>(localBlocks) * TILE;
        if (pitch > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / pitch / sizeof(unsigned int)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Matrix dimensions exceed the addressable size.\n");
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        }
        CudaBuffer<> dist(localRows * pitch), path(localRows * pitch);
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            printf("Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\n");
            printf("Number of nodes: %zu\n", n);
            printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
            printf("MPI ranks: %d; OpenMP threads per rank: %d; CUDA tile: %d\n", ranks, omp_get_max_threads(), TILE);
            printf("Initializing graph...\n");
        }
        {
            std::vector<unsigned int> initial(localRows * pitch);
            initializeLocalDistances(initial, n, pitch, worldRank, ranks);
            cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(dist.data, initial.data(), initial.size() * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        }
        initializePaths<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min(size_t{65535}, (localRows * pitch + 255) / 256)), 256>>>(
            path.data, localRows * pitch, pitch, worldRank, ranks);
        cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError());
        cudaCheck(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
        if (worldRank == 0) printf("Computing shortest paths...\n");
        mpiCheck(MPI_Barrier(comm));
        const double start = MPI_Wtime();
        floydWarshall(dist, path, pitch, blocks, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
        double duration = 0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm));
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", duration * 1000.0);
            const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * n * n;
            printf("Performance: %.3f GOPS\n", duration > 0 ? operations / duration / 1e9 : 0.0);
        }
        std::vector<unsigned int> result, resultPath;
        if (printResults || validate)
            result = gatherMatrix(dist.data, n, pitch, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        if (validate && n <= 256)
            resultPath = gatherMatrix(path.data, n, pitch, localBlocks, worldRank, ranks, comm);
        int status = 0;
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            if (printResults) print_results_int(result, "DistanceMatrix");
            if (validate) {
                printf("Validating result...\n");
                bool valid = validateResult(result, n);
                if (n <= 256) valid = validateExact(result, resultPath, n) && valid;
                printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
                status = valid ? 0 : 1;
            }
        }
        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, comm));
        mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_free(&comm));
        return status;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", worldRank, error.what());
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
        return 1;
    }
}
